description.value: Tse'Khene Food and Fuel is a community-run one-stop hub in the remote village of McLeod Lake, 139 km north of Prince George at the entrance to Carp Lake Provincial Park. It combines a convenience store stocked with basic groceries, a gas bar (unleaded and diesel), the Little Teapot Café serving fresh bannock, soup, and coffee for takeout, and an on-site ATM. An attached four-room B&B (AH'DA) makes it one of the very few places in this sparsely serviced stretch of northern BC where a touring cyclist can resupply, eat, and find overnight shelter.

address.value: 1 Carp Lake Road, McLeod Lake, BC V0J 2G0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active, multi-service business. Washrooms, basic groceries, and hot food are explicitly confirmed by website copy; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible business with a live website confirmed through 2026. A rare resupply point in remote northern BC offering groceries, fuel, hot food, washrooms, ATM, and accommodation.
enrichment_extras.notes: On-site ATM confirmed by front page ('ATM now on premises!'). AH'DA B&B on the same property offers four rooms with Wi-Fi and satellite TV, a notable overnight option for cyclists in this remote area.
